name: LValueData.kernelForm_of_jetDeg_eq_zero
summary: With no derivatives the jets are the theta values: the jet of the jet series is θ, and the coefficient polynomial is the constant 1.

steps.claim: Unfold kernelForm and write the matrix product as a sum.
The sum of the jets of the jet series is the theta value (`jet_jetSeries_eq_theta`), and the integrated finite Weil action is that of the finite part (`pairWeil_integrated_fin`).
steps.lean:
erw [← LinearMap.sum_apply, ← map_sum, jet_jetSeries_eq_theta,
    ← pairWeil_integrated_fin]; congr; simp [AuxPair.a]

steps.claim: The coefficient polynomial is 1: the Schur sum with dg = 0 is the constant (`sum_schur_smul_nablaBasis`, `nablaBasis_eq_one`), compared through the injectivity of constants (`MvPolynomial.C_injective`).
steps.lean:
apply C_injective; simpa [nablaBasis_eq_one, schurDetExp, k, smul_eq_C_mul] using
    sum_schur_smul_nablaBasis X.isLiftWeight.1 ..
